reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New Mexico
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law regulating residential evictions specify the type(s) of landlord(s) regulated?

    Statute provided (translated): NM Stat  47-10-2 (2021) (Mobile Home Park Act definitions),
    which defines "landlord" or "management" to include specific types of persons/entities.
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario (facts from question)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(new_mexico).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question is about whether the eviction-regulating law specifies landlord types.
scenario_issue(specifies_landlord_types_in_eviction_law).

/* Helper that succeeds when the factual scenario is set (for reuse). */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(new_mexico),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_issue(specifies_landlord_types_in_eviction_law).

% ---------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translation: NM Stat  47-10-2 (2021) definitions
% ---------------------------------------------------------

/* We treat the Mobile Home Park Act as a residential-eviction-related body of law because it governs
   mobile home park tenancies and related landlord/resident relations (including eviction contexts). */
statute_eviction_regulating_law(new_mexico, 2021, mobile_home_park_act).

/* NM Stat  47-10-2(A) (2021):
   "landlord" or "management" means:
     - the owner; OR
     - any person responsible for operating and managing a mobile home park; OR
     - an agent, employee, or representative authorized to act on management's behalf
       in connection with matters relating to tenancy in the park.
*/
statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(owner).
statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(person_responsible_for_operating_and_managing_mobile_home_park).
statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(agent_authorized_to_act_for_management_in_tenancy_matters).
statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(employee_authorized_to_act_for_management_in_tenancy_matters).
statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(representative_authorized_to_act_for_management_in_tenancy_matters).

/* Derived: statute specifies landlord types if it enumerates one or more categories. */
statute_specifies_landlord_types(mobile_home_park_act) :-
    statute_nm_47_10_2_landlord_category(_),
    !.

% ---------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning: answer the question from statute + facts
% ---------------------------------------------------

/* For the scenario jurisdiction/year, check if any eviction-regulating law specifies landlord types. */
jurisdiction_has_eviction_law_specifying_landlord_types(State, Year) :-
    statute_eviction_regulating_law(State, Year, Act),
    statute_specifies_landlord_types(Act),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Final answer (yes / no)
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    jurisdiction_has_eviction_law_specifying_landlord_types(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint required
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law regulating residential evictions specify the type(s) of landlord(s) regulated?
